job_posting.title: Clinical Care Coordinator / Registered Nurse
job_posting.description_plain:
Oversee multidisciplinary patient care pathways, triage protocols, and clinical documentation within Epic EHR.

Statutory Licensing Requirement under National Nursing and Midwifery Commission Act, 2023:
- Active licence to practise as a Registered Nurse & Midwife enrolled in the State Register or National Register under Sections 24, 25, and 27 of the NNMC Act, 2023.

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of clinical nursing or care coordination experience.
- Hands-on proficiency with Epic Hospital EHR.
- Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).

mandatory_constraints: Active Licence to Practise as Registered Nurse & Midwife enrolled under NNMC Act, 2023 (or recognized State/National Register)

education_status.status_stated: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

experience.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
experience.description: Architected low-latency transaction processing APIs in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript (React), deployed on AWS ECS with PostgreSQL.

evidence_facts.statement: 6 years full-stack Python/FastAPI, TypeScript, and AWS cloud engineering.

intended_evaluation_purpose: Domain mismatch: software developer applied to clinical hospital nurse.
